notesStmt.note: This manuscript was likely composed in the early 1880s, sometime before August 1885.

A manuscript containing an early draft of the poem "Last of Ebb, and Daylight Waning," which was first published in Nineteenth Century magazine in August 1885, as part of a cluster of poems titled "Fancies at Navesink." The cluster, including this poem, then appeared in November Boughs (1888).
